weakest_scene.root_cause: The balance machine maps value to beam height the wrong way round, lifting the larger pan instead of letting it sink. The accent/REST colours leave the REST label below readable contrast. The count-up shows interim values as if they were data.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make weight physical: the 90% damage pan must drop hard and slam down while the ~10% prevention pan flies up. Ideally draw the pans as piles of money or coins so the size difference is visible without reading. Keep both labels in ink at readable contrast. Show only the final values, or clearly mark the count-up as counting.
